name: Orvix
subtitle: Open-source cinematic media hub for iPhone and iPad.
description: Orvix is an open-source media client for discovering, resolving and playing media from user-configured sources and supported services.

apps.name: Orvix
apps.subtitle: Cinematic media hub for iPhone and iPad.
apps.localizedDescription: Orvix for iOS is distributed as an unsigned IPA for AltStore and SideStore. Bring your own supported sources and services.

versions.localizedDescription: First Orvix iPhone/iPad sideload beta. Supports iOS/iPadOS 15.5 or later. Includes Free P2P live-first source selection and privacy-safe supporters.
